If you've followed me for a while, you know that one of my hobby horses is the importance of having a strong, well-developed ego before you try to transcend it with meditative practice.

To that end, I just published a guided meditation with instructions for traditional Rinzai za-zen, which I think is a foundational practice for developing the physical sense of a centered, grounded self. (The center later gives way, but let's not get ahead of ourselves.)

Like all Zen meditation, it's best to learn from a Zen master or qualified teacher, because it's a subtle practice with a lot of finer points. You'll progress faster. But if you live somewhere that's too far from a Zen center, or you haven't yet found a good teacher online, you can use these instructions.

I know some folks. I believe @DefenderOfBasic gets this, though his project has a slightly broader mandate. @thrialectics also groks this I think. I had a call with @Malcolm_Ocean yesterday where we discussed exactly this. I have a discord server with some mathy weirdos who are exploring some strange notions in this space.

The core idea is that there is this mental construct where the more of it you are able to take on the more you are able to integrate a lot of complexity and reconcile apparent conflict, it’s like a magic shape that heals everything it touches but it’s notoriously difficult to articulate.

Something about, and I’m using toward technically, criticality. That weird stable explosive state where what you metabolize serves the continuation of the process that metabolizes.

I sometimes talk about this thing I call holonic coherence, where for a holon to exist it has to assert itself against its environment but not too strongly lest it crystallize and die, and not too weakly lest it fail to cohere and evaporates.

My project this year is to find a way to put words to this whole thing, and I replied to your tweet because I also see the connection down to physics.

Mcgilchrist is also important here, he identified left hemisphere capture as an important failure mode. I see that as an instance of a more general issue, that’s hypercoherence the crystalline failure of a holon.
